dog.description_text:
Sailor

🐶 Female | Shepherd Mix
From abandoned in a backyard kennel to hopefully finding her forever family at Pumpkins & Pups. ❤️
Sailor is a fun, sweet and VERY playful puppy with quite a story.
She and her brother were discovered after a neighbor heard them in a backyard and went to investigate. They had been left behind in a kennel. Thankfully, that neighbor cared enough to help.
🐶 Fun, sweet & playful
🧸 Loves chew toys
💨 Loves running and playing
🐱 Cat friendly
👧 Loves playing with kids
dog.name: Sailor
